Here's the truth about California's proposed wealth tax that billionaires don't want you to know.

American workers just took home their smallest share of the nation's wealth since 1947 — even as corporate profits soar.

Why? This chart has the answer.

In February, Trump purchased over $1 million in Dell stock.

Just weeks ago, Trump told everyone to “go out and buy a Dell.” Its stock price is up over 60% since then.

Now, Dell has been awarded a $9.7 BILLION Pentagon contract. 

See the problem here?

Trump used to rail against the military industrial complex. Now his family profits from it.

Watch.

I had dinner recently with a group of political operatives who for years have been advising politicians and candidates. During dinner they shared with me their thoughts about how Trump might be removed using the 25th Amendment. I can’t decide whether to be elated or worried.
Trump siccing his DOJ attack dogs against E Jean Carroll is one of the most disgusting things he's done.

Will Trump get away with his brazen pay-to-play stock trades?

Is there really a deal on the table to end his war on Iran?

And what’s going on with his revenge tour?

We try to answer it all on this week’s Coffee Klatch. Join us:

Meta paid its lowest effective federal tax rate in company history last year.

Earlier this month, Meta began laying off 10% of its workforce. 

More than 8,000 people will lose jobs as it ramps up AI investment.

Zuckerberg is now worth $215 billion. 

Second Gilded Age.

Zohran Mamdani is right. Bezos must pay his fair share in taxes.
This is what courage looks like.
Being bullied for my height as a child made acutely aware of how the powerful harass and exploit the vulnerable — and set me on the path of activism.
Trump couldn't make it to his own son's wedding, but there's another way he's still supporting him: lucrative Pentagon contracts to Don Jr.'s (and Eric's) companies.
Over 50 years later, this anti-Vietnam War PSA still rings true.
My friend Robbie went missing in action in Vietnam on October 12, 1972. His body has never been recovered. I think of him every Memorial Day — and what he died fighting for.
Jeff Bezos’s CNBC interview made headlines this week. He’s been on a PR campaign responding to his critics — myself included.
Why am I still hopeful about America, in spite of everything going on today? Because young people are waking up and taking back their future.
